<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.42.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Recognise spark connect datatype. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9954
* Improve dataframe cell error handling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9899
* Update chat input send button hover UI by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10048
* Set `use_container_width=True` by default for charts by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10064
* Update chat input widget border radius by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10047
* Add row hover color to dataframe component by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10104
* Add `height` parameter to `st.code` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10080
* Allow reordering dataframe columns from UI by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10099
* Auth feature by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8786
* Allow markdown in `caption` of `st.image` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10075
* Show elapsed time on `st.spinner` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10072
* Allow reusing existing event loop for server by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10164
* Add support for using categorical index with `st.data_editor` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10195
* Allow markdown in `st.table` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10088
* Preserve scroll position for `st.selectbox` and `st.multiselect` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10073
* Add dataframe column menu with sorting actions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10197
* Allow pinning dataframe columns from UI by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10206
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Preserve target='_blank' for html elements by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9994
* Make st.write use st.html when _repr_html_ is present. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9910
* Fix #10005 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10006
* Do not include source map files in release builds by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10011
* Initialize mimetypes on server initialization by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10010
* Schedule trigger events at the end of the event loop by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10018
* Fix visualization of disabled feedback by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10030
* Prevent tooltips from overflowing on the left or right side by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9983
* Use configured column order for pinned columns by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10034
* Fix handling of empty hierarchical column headers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10035
* Fix issue with dataframe width getting ignored by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10036
* preserve white space sequences and segment breaks in `st.text` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10062
* Make `st.table` rounded by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9823
* Ensure that error is only logged once with rich installed by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10097
* Prevent showing 0 for small numbers in dataframe by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10060
* Refine `st.date_input` to ensure consistent and accurate return types by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9620
* Make st.expander summary respect isStale. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10085
* In st.multiselect, make mouse cursor only be a pointer when hovering the X by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10087
* Remove shortcut to data checking and substitute with a rough hash by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10125
* Deactivate translation for material icons by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10174
* Make widget dropdowns look more consistent + convert `BaseColorPicker` to functional component by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10083
* Add retry to watcher.util.path_modification_time to try and fix race condition. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10148
* Make MPAv2 work with pure Python and with ProcessPoolExecutor by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10163
* Fix the chat input border radius by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10225
* Use `attribute` word instead of `key` in case of AttributeError in st.query_params by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10237
* Force react-syntax-highlighter to cjs build by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10244
* Apply top margin in top-aligned columns to first element instead of last by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10268
### Other Changes
* Release/1.41.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9996
* Fix: Round corners of `st.image` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9999
* Release/1.41.1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10021
* Only show log but don't raise an error when fragment id is not found by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10130
* Update emojis used for validation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10149
* Print st.logo only on first page on the top by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10171
* Remove usage of private snowflake-connector APIs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10122
* Add support for handling raw arrow data by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10191
* Add type annotations so st.altair_chart supports all Altair chart types. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10202
* Update material symbols font and test by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10247
* Remove reading user info from `X-Streamlit-User` header by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10260
* Update file uploader to uses new `accept` value by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10288
